facts.text: Audrey and her dogs enjoy spending time in nature, specifically at a nearby dog park where they play on a big grassy area with shaded spots.

evidence.quote: We took them to the dog park nearby last Saturday. There was a big grassy area for them to play and lots of shaded spots for me to relax.
The pups and I are loving it. Being out in nature and checking out new trails with the dogs is so different from being in the city.

facts.text: Andrew expresses a desire to escape the hustle and bustle of city life and finds being in nature to be a refreshing experience.

evidence.quote: I think everyone's gotta ditch the hustle and bustle every now and then. It's so refreshing to be in nature.

facts.text: Andrew mentions having seen birds up close and admires their ability to fly with grace and freedom.

evidence.quote: I've seen them up close and it's amazing how they fly with grace and freedom.
I love how they can fly around and explore. They have a freedom that I wish I had!
